body_text:
Residue theorem. Let $U\subseteq\mathbb{C}$ be open, let
$f$ be meromorphic on $U$, and let $\gamma$ be a closed
piecewise smooth cycle in $U$ that passes through no pole and is
null-homologous in $U$. If $a_1,\ldots,a_m$ are the poles around
which $\gamma$ has nonzero winding number, then
$\int_\gamma f(z)\,dz=2\pi i\sum_{k=1}^m
\operatorname{Ind}(\gamma,a_k)\operatorname{Res}(f,a_k)$.
